properties.name: One status contract across sibling constructors; a node is named by the key the last tool used; add_project gets its own request shape
properties.rationale: Anthony 2026-09-19: 'prioritize most important and work your way through them one by one' over the flo2 and bhome field reports; F10 is the constructor/setter half of a defect three projects recorded and the 2026-09-06 fix left. Built under the two standing rulings (constructors accept the owner's word in one call, 2026-09-06; type optional and one way to name a node, ruling #3b) rather than a new decision; the open 'four status contracts' idea is left open because its surviving option (echo the status assigned) is not taken here.
properties.summary: service.rs: `status` on ComponentReq/ReleaseReq/AddEpochReq, new ProjectReq (IdName keeps add_interface only), `id`/`node_id` aliases on 25 typed keys, `properties` alias on props ×4; enum_schema.rs: four status helpers; capture.rs/operate_tools.rs/temporal_tools.rs: the four constructors store the status they are told and their descriptions name the landing; adopt skill (+mirrors); two test files; CHANGELOG.
